-- T3c (vi)'s control: `generateIn` exists with the type D1 gives it, and
-- its explicit `∀ s.` lets `seal` take it. Only Features.Check.Generate's
-- export list keeps it from a module that imports that module alone;
-- rule E3, which T3b checks, keeps Generate.Body's importers to Generate*.
module Test.ElabScope.Reached (reached) where

import Data.Either (Either)
import Domain.Checked.Internal as Checked
import Domain.Elaborating (Elaborating)
import Domain.Resolved (FunctionDecl)
import Features.Check.Generate (Signatures, Tables)
import Features.Check.Generate.Body (generateIn)
import Features.Check.Generate.Elab (seal)
import Features.Check.Generate.Fault (GenerationFault)
import Test.ElabScope.Common (header)

reached
  ∷ Tables
  → Signatures
  → FunctionDecl
  → Either GenerationFault (Elaborating Checked.FunctionDecl)
reached tables signatures function =
  seal header (generateIn tables signatures function)
